text:
yana: Quick idea: for the sidebar regroup experiment I'm leaning path-first for deep links but want to explore a compact route alias option for share links. e.g. canonical `/console/models/123/deployments` but also support shortshare `/c/m/123/d` that redirects to canonical. Thoughts on complexity vs benefit?

phil: Path-first all the way. Compact aliases feel clever but add maintenance burden and surprise for devs reading URLs. If we do aliases, keep them as server-side 301s so crawlers/bots see canonical paths. Also keep full routes readable for ops/debugging.

claire-d: +1 on path-first. From UX: breadcrumbs should be human-friendly: "Models > ResNet-XL > Deployments". For shortshare, worry about trust: users might not like obscured links. If we provide them, surface an explicit "Copy short link" action so intent is clear. Copy nit: change any UI text using "master" to "primary".

tom-eng: Impl notes: aliases are doable but we'd need a mapping service to expand `/c/m/123/d` -> canonical before render. Prefer simpler approach: accept a `short=true` query param when user clicks a "Copy short link" button, generate the short url backend and store mapping. But don't accept short paths as first-class routes. Either way, preserve original incoming URL in telemetry before any redirect.

yana: Accessibility considerations: when landing via a deep link (canonical or alias), focus should go to H1. If the left group is collapsed, auto-expand it but do NOT move keyboard focus into nav. Ensure `aria-current="page"` on the active leaf. Add visible skip-to-content link.

phil: Router mechanics: prefer generating route table from nav config and a separate navMap {pattern -> parentKey} so left-nav highlight is deterministic. That avoids brittle startsWith checks. Also: handle legacy `?tab=` -> canonical path via server 301 when possible; fallback to client redirect that reads original URL into telemetry.

claire-d: Breadcrumb behaviour: each crumb should be a canonical link (not alias) and include accessible name. H1s should use "Model details" instead of terse "Model". Also ensure crumb separators use a visible character (›) not just chevrons hidden to screen readers.

tom-eng: Hash anchors: support client-side only. SSR should respond with canonical path (no hash). Client hydrates and smooth-scrolls to `#anchor`. For bots/crawlers, emit `Link: <canonical>; rel="canonical"` headers.

yana: performance/UI nit: avoid client redirects that cause a double data fetch; where possible resolve canonical path server-side and render the final page immediately. If client must redirect, do it once and suppress duplicate fetches.

phil: a11y checklist quick: 1) focus on H1 after nav; 2) `aria-live="polite"` for short route announcements; 3) `aria-expanded` on nav groups; 4) `aria-current="page"` on leaves; 5) skip link visible on focus.

ux-bot: PR opened: `nav/experiment/compact-aliases` -> reviewers requested: @yana @tom-eng. CI: lint + a11y smoke.

yana: ok I'll update the prototype: canonical paths, optional short-link generation behind explicit UI, breadcrumb copy updates, and a 5-line a11y checklist for eng. Will post mocks + a small mapping doc for legacy `?tab=` -> new paths. Thanks! :wave:
